simplifications: tools are grep (ripgrep), glob, read and answer; read-only, no shell or edit tools
tool calls are parsed from the model's text (<tools> blocks), not through a server-side tool API
tool results return as a user message; older reads are digested to a one-line stub at compaction
if the model never calls answer within the turn cap, one call with the uniform answer prompt over the gathered context answers (forced_answer)
